mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, status, scenario_id AS scenarioId, countdown_started_at AS countdownStartedAt, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, initial_cash AS initialCash, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_sessions ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, status, scenario_id AS scenarioId, countdown_started_at AS countdownStartedAt, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, initial_cash AS initialCash, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, status, scenario_id AS scenarioId, countdown_started_at AS countdownStartedAt, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, initial_cash AS initialCash, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_sessions ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE event_sessions SET status = 'COUNTDOWN', countdown_started_at = #{countdownStartedAt}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAITING'

UPDATE event_sessions SET status = 'WAITING', countdown_started_at = NULL, start_at = NULL, end_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status NOT IN ('COUNTDOWN', 'RUNNING')
